label.en: What services does the business associate provide?
label.es: ¿Qué servicios presta el socio comercial (business associate)?

hint.en: A short description, written into the Background as "Company provides ... (the Services)". No full stop at the end.
hint.es: Una descripción breve, que se incluye en los Antecedentes como "Company provides ... (the Services)". Sin punto final.

placeholder.en: e.g. hosted contract drafting software and related support
placeholder.es: p. ej. software alojado de redacción de contratos y soporte relacionado

label.en: Are the services designed to create, receive, maintain or transmit PHI?
label.es: ¿Están los servicios diseñados para crear, recibir, conservar o transmitir PHI?

hint.en: No (the default): the agreement is precautionary and applies only if the business associate in fact handles PHI. Yes: the agreement applies to all the PHI the services handle.
hint.es: No (por defecto): el acuerdo es preventivo y solo se aplica si el socio comercial llega a tratar PHI. Sí: el acuerdo se aplica a toda la PHI que tratan los servicios.

no.en: No, the services are not designed to handle PHI
no.es: No, los servicios no están diseñados para tratar PHI

hint.en: The services agreement this agreement supports, by title and date. If left out, the agreement refers to the services agreements between the parties in general.
hint.es: El contrato de servicios al que acompaña este acuerdo, con su título y fecha. Si no lo indicas, el acuerdo se refiere en general a los contratos de servicios entre las partes.

placeholder.en: e.g. the Master Services Agreement dated 1 March 2026
placeholder.es: p. ej. the Master Services Agreement dated 1 March 2026

parameters.default: the court or arbitration forum designated for disputes in the Underlying Agreement or, if the Underlying Agreement designates none, the state and federal courts located in the State of California

label.es: Tribunales o foro para las controversias

hint.en: Written into Section 21(c). If left out, the forum of the Underlying Agreement applies, and failing that the state and federal courts located in California.
hint.es: Se incluye en la cláusula 21(c). Si no lo indicas, se aplica el foro del contrato principal y, en su defecto, los tribunales estatales y federales con sede en California.

placeholder.en: e.g. the state and federal courts located in Los Angeles County, California
placeholder.es: p. ej. the state and federal courts located in Los Angeles County, California
